% thematic fixture (b) — display-math families in sequence.
% Pins the plain.tex display-alignment family macros used one after another,
% each in its own $$...$$ and separated by running text: \eqalign,
% \eqalignno, \displaylines, \cases.  All four build a \halign/\ialign grid at
% \displaystyle (some via \displ@y's \everycr interline machinery), so their
% row/column positions must byte-compare to MiKTeX within the
% tolerance (+/-0.5pt V / +/-0.1pt H).
\hsize=6.5in
\vsize=8.9in
\nopagenumbers
\noindent
An aligned system
$$\eqalign{x &= y + z\cr a &= b\cr}$$
with a numbered pair
$$\eqalignno{u &= v + w&(1)\cr p &= q&(2)\cr}$$
and two centred lines
$$\displaylines{r = s + t\cr m = n\cr}$$
and a cases construct
$$f(x)=\cases{0&if $x<0$\cr 1&if $x\ge0$\cr}$$
close the sequence.
\par
\bye
